answer: Meter trust as bounded flow across a social attestation graph instead of counting heads. Each real attestation is one edge; an attacker can mint a gale of fake identities, but they reach the honest region only through the handful of genuine edges their operator actually earned. The trust-bandwidth crossing that cut stays capped by those few attack edges no matter how high the sybil tide rises. So weight each identity by the min-cut flow it can draw from a trusted basalt core, not by its self-declared links; fakes beyond that bandwidth simply starve.
